description: Pick ONE venue for a job (trade memecoins, snipe, copy trade, track wallets, best swap price, perps, prediction markets, first buy with a card, wallet, launch a token, scan a token, crypto taxes), optionally on a chain, available in a country (US, UK, EU), by custody and on a phone. Returns the pick, the number that decided it (30-day usage from DefiLlama, round-trip fee, perps taker fee, or DexSheet's fewest-steps order), its referral code when DexSheet has one, and a runner-up with a factual reason to choose it instead. Uses the same filter and ranking as the dexsheet.com/best/ pages; referrals never change the ranking.

country.description: Optional country: US, UK or an EU country (availability is tracked for these). Venues with unverified availability there are left out; partly available ones are flagged.

custody.description: "self" = non-custodial only; "embedded_ok" = non-custodial or an embedded wallet; "any" (default).

job.description: What the person wants to do.

mobile.description: true = must work on a phone (iOS app, Android app or Telegram bot).

prefer.description: Override the ranking: "popular" = 30-day usage, "cheapest" = lowest fee. Default: the job's own /best/ ranking.

name: recommend_venue
title: Recommend one venue for a job
